name: Oracle tool verifier
description: Checks an http-transport registry listing's claims automatically: calls the declared endpoint (SSRF-guarded: scheme allowlist, private/loopback address blocking, no redirects, timeout and size caps) and validates the response against the listing's declared JSON Schema. Prefers machine-checkable verification over social trust.

spec.install: git clone https://github.com/Technosophorso/oracle.git && cd oracle && npm install
spec.command: npm run verify -- check <listing-tx-id> [--gateway url] [--timeout ms]
